title: APO Tarragon Chicken Cutlets with Lemon Cream Gravy
description: Thin chicken breast cutlets poach in full steam and are served with an extra ladle of light tarragon cream gravy.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

ingredients.name: unenhanced boneless skinless chicken breast
ingredients.note: Butterfly into cutlets; no injected brine.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water without a vegetable seasoning blend.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Fill the water tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 175°F with sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 165°F.

steps.title: Even the cutlets
steps.text: Place {chicken} between sheets of parchment and gently flatten the thick ends to 1/2 inch with a meat mallet.

steps.title: Probe the chicken
steps.text: Arrange the cutlets unbagged in the shallow pan on the middle rack. Insert the probe sideways through the thickest center. Begin cooking immediately and set a separate 15-minute reminder for the first temperature check; respond sooner if the probe signals.

steps.title: Steep the tarragon
steps.text: Meanwhile simmer {broth} and {tarragon} in the HexClad, covered, for 4 minutes. Strain and return the broth to the skillet.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Make the cream finish
steps.text: Blend {cheese} with a spoonful of warm gravy, whisk it back into the pan off heat and stir in {lemon}.

steps.title: Steam until cooked through
steps.text: Cook in full steam for about 17–35 minutes, checking from 15 minutes. Verify that each cutlet reaches 165°F, then cover it loosely with its juices.

steps.title: Give each cutlet extra gravy
steps.text: Slice the chicken thinly across the grain. Place each serving in a pool of gravy, then pour the remaining gravy across the cut faces.

notes: Make ahead: Flatten the cutlets a day ahead and refrigerate covered. Add the cream cheese just before serving for the smoothest sauce. Option A has a little lemon. For gentler Option B, omit it. For dairy-free gravy, leave out the cream cheese or use an unsweetened dairy-free equivalent. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze the cutlets in the starch-thickened tarragon gravy for up to 2 months. Add cream cheese and lemon after reheating for the best texture. Fridge reheat: Place one portion and its sauce in a shallow covered dish. Install the APO bottom drip pan and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Insert the probe in the coldest center and set it to 165°F. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw a single portion in the refrigerator overnight, then use the fridge reheating method. Stir the sauce until smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 205 kcal, 33.2 g protein, 3.8 g total carbohydrate, 5.3 g fat, 0.0 g fiber, 99 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
